segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Thanks for calling support, this is Maya. Can I get your company name and the email on your account?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yeah, so this is Daniel from North Ridge Logistics. Email is daniel.cho@northridgelogistics.com.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Thanks, Daniel. I have North Ridge pulled up. What can I help with today?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: We just need a copy of the May invoice for accounting. I think it was paid on June 3, but I can't find the PDF in the admin console.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Sure. Let me check the billing tool. Was that for the monthly subscription, 42 seats?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yep, that's the one. Should be around two thousand something.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: I found it. Invoice 10487, dated May 31, total was $2,184.00, and it shows paid on June 3 by ACH.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. Can you send it to me and copy ap@northridgelogistics.com?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Yes. I just sent the PDF to your email and copied that AP address. You should see it in a minute or two.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Got it already. That’s all we needed.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Great. I’ll note the ticket as resolved. Your reference number is 58231 if you need it later.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Thanks, Maya. Have a good one.
